description.en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh: Chinese

- en: English
Specifies whether to perform a cascading delete.
The unique ID of the gateway.
The ID of the security group rule.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse delete-security-group-rule --gateway-unique-id gw-83b0ddb569434f82b9fe8e4c60c40f7c --id 93 --cascading-delete true --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun mse DeleteSecurityGroupRule --region cn-hangzhou --GatewayUniqueId 'gw-83b0ddb569434f82b9fe8e4c60c40f7c' --CascadingDelete true --AcceptLanguage zh --Id 93
